editorial.blurb: Silli Kori is a warm neighborhood Thai spot on Division Street where khao soi and curry dishes arrive fragrant and carefully crafted, best visited when you're ready to linger over a bowl.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the khao soi and ask about spice level—reviewers praise its layered heat and balance, and pair it with Thai iced tea; note they open late on weekends, so plan accordingly.
